query: SELECT coalesce(sum(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens), 0)::bigint AS "tokens!", coalesce(sum(cost), 0) AS "cost!", coalesce(sum(requests - errors), 0)::bigint AS "succeeded!" FROM usage_daily WHERE project_id = $1 AND ($2 <> 'member' OR user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3 AND service_account_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR api_key_id = $5) AND ($6::uuid IS NULL OR catalogue_model_id = $6) AND ($7::date IS NULL OR day >= $7)
